answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity at the graph edge, not after votes land. A claimant becomes a spendable vertex only after locking a bond that grows with unused sibling keys, then surviving a prism of independent checks: bond age, unique hardware attestations, and a clean unpaid-settlement record. Only when those rays agree does the agent enter the settlement garden. Cheap clones fail first—each extra identity multiplies lockup and delay—so farming votes costs more than the votes can return.
